items.title: Perioperative Interventions to Reduce Edema and Ecchymosis After Rhinoplasty: A Network Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
items.fact_zh: 36项RCT网络meta：激素消肿退瘀最稳；氨甲环酸只对早期瘀斑有效（SMD -0.80）。
items.take_zh: 激素是唯一稳定的；激素+氨甲环酸的“最佳组合”证据等级低，只能算假设，别当定论。
items.scene_zh: 消肿药里激素最靠谱，氨甲环酸锦上添花；所谓组合最优，证据还不够硬。
items.fact_en: In a network meta-analysis of 36 randomized trials, corticosteroids consistently reduced post-rhinoplasty edema and ecchymosis, while tranexamic acid only modestly reduced early ecchymosis (SMD -0.80).
items.take_en: Corticosteroids were the only consistently supported agent; the corticosteroid-plus-TXA combination ranked highest on SUCRA but rests on sparse indirect evidence rated low to very low certainty.

items.title: Iatrogenic pseudoaneurysm formation in the medial orbitofrontal artery following rhinoplasty and nasal osteotomy: A case report
items.fact_zh: 31岁男鼻整形截骨后颅内出血，造影见内侧眶额动脉假性动脉瘤，显微夹闭后无后遗症。
items.take_zh: 截骨后头痛、呕吐、意识变化别只当麻醉反应；尽早血管造影，罕见但致命。
items.scene_zh: 隆鼻截骨后剧烈头痛、喷射性呕吐，先排颅内出血，别急着说“麻药还没过”。
items.fact_en: A 31-year-old man developed intracerebral hemorrhage after rhinoplasty with osteotomy; angiography showed a medial orbitofrontal artery pseudoaneurysm, treated by microsurgical trapping and clipping with complete neurological recovery.
items.take_en: Intracranial pseudoaneurysm after osteotomy is rare but catastrophic, so post-rhinoplasty hemorrhage and neuro symptoms warrant prompt vascular imaging instead of watchful waiting.

items.title: Quantifying Facial Rejuvenation after Deep Plane Facelift Using Convolutional Neural Network-Based Age Estimation: Correlation with Patient-Reported Outcomes on the FACE-Q Aesthetic Module
items.fact_zh: 72例深层除皱，5个AI模型估龄降7.64岁（15.7%），与FACE-Q弱相关（ρ 0.25）。
items.take_zh: AI估龄可当客观指标，但病人自评年轻多少才是主结局；两者的数别混着报。
items.scene_zh: 照片测出来年轻七岁半，可病人满不满意，还得看问卷，不是看算法。
items.fact_en: In 72 deep-plane face and neck lifts, five CNN models estimated a mean age reduction of 7.64 years (15.7%), but AI estimates correlated only weakly with FACE-Q scores (rho 0.25).
items.take_en: AI age estimation is reproducible as an objective metric, yet patient-perceived rejuvenation correlated far more strongly (rho 0.61) and should stay the primary outcome.

items.title: The Distal U-Shaped Capsule Sparing Technique (DUS-CS) for Revision Breast Augmentation: A Consecutive Clinical Series of 223 Patients
items.fact_zh: 223例包膜挛缩翻修用U形保留包膜技术，现有随访内无复发、无双乳相通、无下移。
items.take_zh: 留部分包膜能稳住腔隙、少创伤；但这是单中心描述性研究，随访时长没写，别当治愈率。
items.scene_zh: 挛缩不一定全切包膜，留一部分反而稳；长期复发率现在还没数。
items.fact_en: In 223 consecutive revision augmentations, a U-shaped selective capsulectomy sparing medial, lateral and caudal capsule produced no recurrence of contracture, symmastia or bottoming out during available follow-up.
items.take_en: Capsule-sparing revision preserves pocket geometry with less morbidity, but this single-center descriptive series does not report follow-up duration and cannot establish a recurrence rate.

items.title: A Modified Pre-implantation Internal Fixation Suture Technique for Inframammary Fold Reconstruction in Implant-Based Breast Augmentation: A Retrospective Cohort Study
items.fact_zh: 53例下皱襞入路用改良内固定缝法，3例假体下移<5mm，无翻修，平均随访12个月。
items.take_zh: 技术可行，但“满意度100%”出自单术者回顾、无对照；假体位置得看更长期。
items.scene_zh: 下皱襞多缝一道确实不容易往下掉；百分百满意这种话，听听就好。
items.fact_en: In 53 IMF-approach augmentations using a modified internal fixation suture, 3 implants displaced less than 5 mm inferiorly, none needed revision, and mean follow-up was 12 months.
items.take_en: The technique is feasible for fold support, but a single-surgeon retrospective series claiming 100% satisfaction cannot establish superiority over standard closure.
